data.name: Elbafoon
data.long_meaning: Elbafoon is a name that derives from the Arabic language, and it is a combination of two words: 'el-ba' which means monkey, and 'foon' which means banana. The name Elbafoon evokes the image of a monkey happily holding and eating a banana, symbolizing joy and happiness.

The banana, on the other hand, represents nourishment, growth, and renewal. Together, Elbafoon represents the playful and intelligent side of human nature, as well as the desire for nourishment and growth in life.
